ConnectionStrings._comment: Not used. The SQL connection string is composed at runtime by SqlConnectionFactory from the Database:* values, which arrive as Database__Host / Database__Name / Database__User / Database__Password environment variables injected from AWS Parameter Store and Secrets Manager. Never add a literal connection string here.

SsoSettings._comment: Entra ID for internal users. Secrets arrive as SsoSettings__ClientSecret from Secrets Manager; never store them here.
